serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Wait a minute. 
My bot was here the whole time, right? So maybe she knows something about my coffee machine acting up.
You: I have a question for you {f_botName}.
Bot: Yes?
You: Do you perhaps know something about weird things that were happening to my coffee machine? You were here when it happened, right? 
Bot: Yes.
You: Oh, ok. {{wi}}So, what happened?
Bot: It was my doing.
You: Really? But why? You scared shit out of me!
Bot: I had no intention of scaring you. I am doing my best in serving you.
